display.purpose: Screen titles and the single most important metric.

label.purpose: Short labels, freshness, badges, and compact controls.

shadows.name: active-glow
shadows.purpose: Selected tabs, live leader, and completed primary action.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Selection, permission, sync, and feedback state changes.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Use for the single clearest action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C7FF00; color: #111211; padding: 14px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; transition: background 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8EBA00; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4F5EE; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Score Card
components.description: Tonal container for a metric, ranking row, or permission state.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #1C1D1C; color: #F4F5EE; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #343632; border-radius: 16px; }

components.name: Selected Navigation
components.description: The active destination in the five-tab mobile navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-selected { background: #C7FF00; color: #111211; padding: 10px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4F5EE; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Enfermicambio should feel like opening the private scoreboard of a small, competitive sports club. It is dark, immediate, and a little cheeky, but it never sacrifices the trust needed for health data.
keyCharacteristics: Orange reserved for heat, calories, duels, and warnings.
Bold hierarchy with calm secondary copy.
Flat surfaces with state-based emphasis rather than permanent shadows.

rules.name: Accent-Has-a-Job Rule
rules.body: Lime and orange must communicate a state or action.

rules.name: Number-First Rule
rules.body: Numeric values use tabular figures, strong weight, and enough surrounding space to scan at a glance.

rules.name: Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: A screen should still be legible if all shadows are removed.

dos: Do make today's competition the first meaningful visual on HOY.
Do use Scoreboard Lime for the selected tab, primary action, progress, and current leader.
Do pair every permission or sync error with a recovery action.
donts: Don't make the interface look like a clinical or medical dashboard.
Don't use casino-like gamification, random rewards, virtual currency, or excessive animation.
Don't communicate rank, freshness, permission, or failure with color alone.
